target_fidelity.note: It is present perfect, active, negative, declarative, with no modal.

grammaticality.note: The target answer is grammatical English.

naturalness.note: An untouched breakfast at noon naturally supports the response.

pedagogical_suitability.note: The cue and context focus clearly on forming the present perfect negative.

determinacy.note: Other equally natural responses, such as adding “yet” or using “her breakfast,” are not accepted.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: The vocabulary and context are common and transparent.

no_answer_leakage.note: The prompt gives lexical cues but does not display the completed target form.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: No unrelated advanced grammar is needed.

no_world_knowledge.note: No external factual or specialist knowledge is required.
